drafts.text:
Someone in my replies yesterday put it better than I have in months.
The 50k wasn't edge. It was room to be human in.
It wasn't making me trade better, it was absorbing the days I traded worse.
The 25k took that room away. Now every broken rule lands the same day I break it.
Size was never the problem. It was the cover.
drafts.source: Built directly on the still-warm 9 sep '50k vs 25k' thread. @RealizedTrader's reply (5 likes): 'the 50k wasn't giving you edge, it was giving you room to be human in.' Backed by @KutKeeper: 'I was getting away with the same bad habits on the 50k, the 25k doesn't forgive.'
drafts.why: Builds on a post that already worked (2.5K, 13 replies) while it's still in people's feeds, using the audience's own sharpest line. Real realization Jesus can own, honest close, no fake fix. Confession format continues the account's strongest lane.
drafts.why_es: Se apoya en un post que ya funcionó (2.5K, 13 respuestas) mientras sigue en los feeds de la gente, usando la frase más afilada de la propia audiencia. Realización real que Jesus puede reconocer como suya, cierre honesto, sin arreglo falso. El formato confesión sigue el carril más fuerte de la cuenta.

drafts.text:
The bigger account never made me a better trader.
It just let me be a worse one for longer before it showed.
Same entries. Same oversizing. The 50k had the room to eat it. The 25k sends the bill that day.
I didn't need less drawdown. I needed to stop needing the extra room.
drafts.source: Same 9 sep thread. @aces_and_8s (6 likes, blunt): 'if you're having trouble with risk management, why on earth would you buy yourself less drawdown?' + @chartsmeancash: re-run it in R, if the ratio matches on both sizes then size was never the problem.
drafts.why: Takes the uncomfortable contradiction a commenter threw at him and owns it instead of defending it. Punchy, short lines, hard close. Truth-bomb format rotates off the confession.
drafts.why_es: Toma la contradicción incómoda que un comentarista le lanzó y la reconoce en vez de defenderse. Líneas cortas y contundentes, cierre duro. El formato truth-bomb rota respecto a la confesión.

drafts.text:
A guy in my replies called it what it is. Addictive.
I told him back the plan I keep skipping: get paid, stop buying.
The buying is the addiction. Not the losing. The buying.
I know this now. Doesn't mean I stop tonight.
drafts.source: Jesus's own real reply (71 likes) to @NordicTrades's "it's addictive" (104 likes) on the 6 sep receipts post. Still unposted after 3 days, carried from cycle #7.
